hero.title: SEO Services for Businesses in the US and Europe
hero.lead:
Search engine optimization is not a one-time task. It is a long-term investment in your website’s ability to attract the right audience, without paying for every click.

At Tarasovs Digital Agency, we build SEO strategies that combine technical precision, content structure, and authority signals — helping businesses in the United States and Europe rank higher on Google and get discovered across modern search platforms, including AI-powered tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Every SEO engagement starts with understanding your business, your audience, and the competitive landscape — not with a generic checklist.

items.title: Technical SEO Audit & Optimization
items.html: We analyze your site’s technical foundation and fix what holds it back — before building visibility on a shaky base.

items.title: Keyword Research Intent Mapping
items.html: We identify the keywords your target audience actually uses — not just high-volume terms, but phrases that signal intent to hire, buy, or engage. We then map those keywords to specific pages and content opportunities across your site.

items.title: On-Page SEO Optimization
items.html: Every page on your website sends signals to search engines. We optimize those signals systematically — from headings and metadata to internal linking and content structure.

items.title: Content Strategy SEO Copywriting
items.html: We develop a content plan aligned with your keyword strategy — and write or restructure the content itself.

items.title: Link Building Authority Development
items.html: External links remain one of Google’s strongest ranking signals. We build high-quality backlinks through editorial outreach, digital PR, and strategic partnerships — not through shortcuts that risk penalties.

items.title: Local SEO US & European Markets
items.html: For businesses targeting clients in specific cities or regions, local SEO drives high-intent traffic from people actively searching in your area. We optimize for Google Maps, local search results, and geo-targeted content.

items.title: SEO Reporting Analytics
items.html: We provide clear, monthly reporting on rankings, traffic, and conversions — without inflated metrics or vague summaries. You always know what was done, what changed, and what comes next.

items.title: Discovery & Audit
items.html: Full technical audit, keyword research, and competitor analysis. A clear picture of where your website stands and what is holding it back.

items.title: Strategy & Roadmap
items.html: We present a prioritized SEO roadmap — structured by impact and effort. You know exactly what we will work on and why.

items.title: Implementation
items.html: Technical fixes, on-page optimizations, content improvements, and ongoing link building across the engagement.

items.title: Monitor & Iterate
items.html: We monitor rankings, analyze traffic, adjust the strategy based on data, and report progress every month.

items.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.a: Most websites start seeing measurable ranking improvements within 3 to 6 months. Competitive niches or websites with significant technical issues may take longer. SEO compounds over time — the earlier you start, the stronger your position becomes.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside New York?
items.a: Yes. We serve clients across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe. Our work is fully remote, and we have experience targeting both US and European search markets.

items.q: What makes your SEO different from other agencies?
items.a: We do not separate SEO from web development. When we identify a technical issue, we fix it. When a page needs better content, we write it. Most agencies stop at recommendations — we execute.
Yes. If you need a comprehensive SEO audit without an ongoing retainer, we offer standalone technical and content audits. Contact us to discuss the scope.

items.q: Can SEO help me appear in ChatGPT or Google AI answers?
items.a: Yes — this is what we call GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). It requires structured content, strong authority signals, and FAQ schema. We integrate GEO into our SEO process across all packages.

Every month you receive a report covering keyword rankings, organic traffic, technical issue status, backlink growth, and the plan for the next 30 days. Strategy calls are held at a frequency matched to your package.

items.q: What do you need from us to get started?
items.a: Access to your Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and a call to align on your business goals and target audience. Everything else we handle.

cta.title: Ready to Build Sustainable Organic Growth?
cta.text: Tell us about your business and your current SEO challenges. We will review your website and come back with an honest assessment and a clear proposal — no vague promises, no hard sell.
